title: Environmental Management and Climate Change Act 2020 (Act No. 34 of 2020)
citation: Environmental Management and Climate Change Act 2020 No 34 (GN No 787/2020; Gaz 195/2020)
evidence: Table of Amendments: "The Environmental Management and Climate Change Act 2020 No 34 was certified and commenced 23 October 2020 (GN No 787/2020; Gaz 195/2020)." Section 2: "This Act commences upon certification by the Speaker and came into effect on 23 October 2020." Read in the RONLAW compilation https://ronlaw.gov.nr/assets/docs/acts/2020/Environmental%20Management%20and%20Climate%20Change%20Act%202020_serv6.pdf on 2026-11-09.
notes: F2 framework act: environmental management and climate change in one text (Part 8, s 39 Addressing climate change; Part 9, ss 40-42 Climate Change and Environment Protection Fund). The only version RONLAW serves is the current compilation in the Laws of the Republic of Naoero, printed 2026-10-16 (Service 6); the as-enacted texts are not served as acts (the 2020 Bill is under bills). The record is dated the commencement of the latest amendment the compilation reflects. Record text is the pages of this instrument cut from the whole RONLAW PDF (which holds several instruments) with pdftotext -layout and runs of spaces collapsed; the dotless i in a few words (for example "offıcer") is how the PDF font extracts the "fi" ligature, left uncorrected. English only: Nauru enacts in English and RONLAW serves no Nauruan text.
